integrity: All reported finite rational values are produced by included stand-alone code implementing exact transient Markov equations and complete marked-edge orbit enumeration. No external validation or broader universal novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact expected-update classification for independent fair initial binary states. Exhaustive through four vertices; five-vertex link-dynamics result is a single existence witness. Does not cover balanced-only initial states, successful-flip clocks, adaptive networks, or other update rules.
title: Sharp edge-addition slowdowns in three finite voter-consensus rules
